newsitem.title: USA: Pa. commission sets $1.8 bln Pittsburgh projects.
newsitem.headline: Pa. commission sets $1.8 bln Pittsburgh projects.

text.p: Pennsylvania's Transportation Commission said on Friday that it approved $1.8 billion in highway and bridge projects for the six-county Pittsburgh region.

The move brings the state's 12-year planned spending program to $20.2 billion for the construction and maintenance of the state's highways, bridges, mass transit systems, airports and freight rail lines.

In breaking down the figures among types of projects, the Commission said the statewide total for highway, bridge and intermodal projects would be $5.6 billion over the next four years and $12.4 billion over the 12-year, 1997-2008 period.
The 12-year program also includes $5.6 billion for public transit, $1.9 billion for aviation and $191 million for rail freight, bringing the statewide total to $20.2 billion for 1997-2008.
